Name: The Mane Event - Horse Customizer
Author: Zhuria
Description:
[size=3][center]﻿My horse retextures from 2016 are back! Now with TONS more features. Choose from 19 (currently) premade skins from pop culture and real horse breeds, or customize your own horse from the coat colour to the face and leg markings to the tack!

This is a work in progress and I've got plans to add tons more colours, markings, tack and accessories <3 Thank you for eight years of supporting my mods![/center]
[/size][center][b][font=Georgia]
[size=6]Includes:[/size]
[size=3] [/size]
[/font][/b][size=3]Premade horse skins[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Nacjp9K.png[/img]﻿
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/A2wnMrF.png[/img][/size]
 
Custom horses - choose your base colour, markings and tack all in-game within Generic Mod Config Menu!
[size=1] [/size][size=3]﻿[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cO8Bnqh.png[/img]﻿

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/UryEbXP.png[/img]
You can choose one facial marking each from Snips & Muzzles, Stripes & Blazes﻿ and Stars. Each leg is individually customizable!
Combine them to get the horse you want!

[/size][size=2]Pinto, appaloosa, roan etc. are all planned but as yet unimplemented[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2DuZYcV.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lZV7roW.png[/img]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/bfGKpuY.png[/img]﻿
You can choose one bridle OR one halter; they're all found in the same menu.
You can also choose a snaffle or shank bit and the hardware style for your halter (they're literally 1-2 pixels though ;p)

[size=2]More tack and accessories planned![/size][/center][left][size=3]
[/size][u][b][size=3]Other
[/size][/b][/u][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Setting to remove reins from farmer sprite[/size]
[*][size=3]Setting to enable or disable horse head menu icons matching your chosen horse skin (markings and bridles currently excluded)[/size]
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=3](optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for easy config[/size][size=4] setting management[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b][u]Configure[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]I highly recommend [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] to change your settings, especially if you want to use the customization feature. You can also edit the [/size][font=Courier New]config.json[/font][size=3] file that appears the first time you run the game with the mod.[/size]

[b][u][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]Should be compatible with pretty much everything aside from other horse retextures. Works well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url], and saddle bags are planned to be added that will work in tandem with it!
﻿[/size]

[size=3]These include all of my original horses from way back in 2016, now officially converted to work with Content Patcher and Stardew Valley 1.6. Enjoy![/size]
[color=#999999][size=1](now with 100% less XNB!)[/size][/color]

[list]
[/list][size=3]Should you encounter any issues please feel free to comment, report a bug or message me on Discord - my username is sepzero
